subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider that sends web_search queries to Firecrawl's keyless hosted tier despite the mixed upstream REST-auth documentation?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and live no-auth search currently works, but accepting a new hosted no-credential search route is a product/privacy/security-boundary choice that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept after conflict and docs cleanup
options.body: Merge the opt-in provider after resolving conflicts, keeping no auto-selection, credential isolation, and updated user-facing docs for the new provider id.

options.title: Keep search keyed for now
options.body: Drop `firecrawl-free` from the branch and retain only the richer keyed `firecrawl_search` parameter expansion.

options.title: Pause for clearer upstream contract
options.body: Wait until Firecrawl's public API reference consistently documents direct REST keyless search before exposing it as an official OpenClaw provider.

recommendation.title: Accept after conflict and docs cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the opt-in provider after resolving conflicts, keeping no auto-selection, credential isolation, and updated user-facing docs for the new provider id.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the merged Firecrawl keyless scrape path and merged the key-free web_search opt-in policy this PR relies on.
